prelaunch_corrections: The v1 producer conflated intervention decision gates with diagnostic validity, so the preregistered FULL_ONLY_PASS and CANONICAL_REPAIR_REFUTED outcomes would have been mislabeled as failed jobs. Schema v2 separates validity, decision gates, outcome labels, and exit status; every valid diagnostic outcome exits zero.
The v1 producer reported but did not assert the exact L_ref=5 and model reference_length=8 contract. Schema v2 requires both exact values before bundle construction.

The v1 prose overclaimed bitwise replay of compacted cells against job 304002, whose NPZ did not persist connectivity. Schema v2 claims only what can be checked: prior IDs/coordinates/internal geometry/predictions replay bitwise, while regenerated current topology must agree exactly across selected, primary, fixed, and canonical arms.
Independent JSON/NPZ recomputation is a post-run publication gate performed outside the producer, not an in-producer validity claim.
scientific_role: Target-free engineering-validity and causal-transfer diagnostic only. It is not an H-QC rerun, an accuracy experiment, or an architecture verdict.
question: Does one prespecified source/query geometry frame built from the raw selected subset before either historical CenterMesh remove primary-versus-fixed translation sensitivity without choosing either observed arm?

hypotheses.H_CANONICAL_FULL: Sharing one coherent neutral points/centroids/areas/normals bundle and its trace centroids makes primary- and fixed-path pressure and WSS predictions bitwise identical.
hypotheses.H_CANONICAL_DERIVED: Sharing only the neutral centroids/areas/normals and trace centroids while retaining each historical path's internal source points keeps both prediction fields within relative L2 0.001.

prior_knowledge.job_303890: All four bfloat16 K=2500 canaries exceeded the frozen pressure-prediction center tolerance; no H-QC case or lane completed.
job_304002: Saved pipeline normals were bitwise null and the normalized-query route was below 0.001 for both fields in every case and precision.
Pinning primary centroids, areas, and normals into the fixed path was already below 0.001 for every case, field, and precision; maxima were 0.0000309113 for pressure and 0.000174939 for WSS.
Pinning full primary points, centroids, areas, and normals was already bitwise exact.
Whole-forward float32 failed its all-four pressure gate and WSS failed on all four cases.
prior_knowledge.epistemic_status: This is not an independent confirmation of geometry-pin sufficiency or H-QC. The only new engineering evidence is whether a neutral raw-derived third frame, owned by neither historical arm and supplied symmetrically, satisfies the frozen contracts. The four cases are mechanism canaries, not a new population holdout.

focused_test.result: 14 passed; Ruff check/format, py_compile, and CLI help passed

canonical_geometry_contract.input: The selected raw float32 point coordinates and exact compacted topology before either per-K or fixed-S10000 external CenterMesh.
construction: Promote the selected raw coordinates exactly once to float64.
In float64 compute oriented triangle cross products, geometric areas, unit normals, and centroids.
Use the prespecified physical scale L_ref * model_reference_length = 5 * 8 = 40.
Define points=(X-c0)/40, centroids=(C-c0)/40, areas=A/40^2, and leave unit normals unchanged.
Cast each completed points/centroids/areas/normals tensor exactly once to float32.
Use canonical centroids as the trace-query tensor.
canonical_geometry_contract.neutrality: Neither historical center nor either arm's prediction enters c0, the scale, or any bundle field. There is no primary/fixed averaging, nearest-arm selection, grid snapping, or outcome-dependent alternate formula.
canonical_geometry_contract.reuse: Build the bundle once per case and reuse the identical tensors in both historical paths.
canonical_geometry_contract.exact_scale_gate: Observed L_ref must equal 5.0 exactly and observed model reference_length must equal 8.0 exactly before bundle construction; positive-but-different values are invalid inputs.

arms.historical_replay: Untouched primary-per-K and fixed-S10000 encode/decode paths, included only as bitwise provenance controls against job 304002.
arms.canonical_derived: Retain each path's internally constructed source points; inject the identical neutral centroids, areas, and normals at the earliest source consumer; decode with center zero and reference length one at identical canonical trace centroids.
arms.canonical_full: Inject the identical neutral points, centroids, areas, and normals at the earliest source consumer; decode with center zero and reference length one at identical canonical trace centroids.
arms.same_input_replay: Repeat the primary model arm once for each intervention, case, and precision.

target_exclusion_and_blinding.raw_reader_container_caveat: Raw supervision arrays may exist in the reader container, but their keys and values may not be indexed, copied, transformed, passed to the model, logged, hashed individually, scored, or persisted.
target_exclusion_and_blinding.implementation: Construct a geometry-only compacted mesh with synthetic zero placeholders required only to traverse the historical field transforms, then strip every interior and boundary point/cell data association before model encode. Retain only topology and required global metadata.
forbidden_outputs_or_labels: H-QC endpoint ratios or log cliffs
Support, futility, mixed, or eligibility labels

comparison_definition.relative_l2: norm(a-b)_2 / max(norm(a)_2, norm(b)_2, 1e-12), accumulated in float64
comparison_definition.exact: Same shape and dtype and torch.equal; relative L2 zero alone is insufficient.
comparison_definition.no_pooling: Never average across fields, cases, or precisions.

required_validity_gates: All frozen input, prior JSON/NPZ, source-tree, script, and checkpoint hashes pass.
Selected IDs/order and primary/fixed transformed points/query points replay job 304002 bitwise.

Current compacted topology is regenerated deterministically from the frozen raw IDs/connectivity and agrees exactly across selected, primary, fixed, and canonical arms. Job 304002 did not persist connectivity, so no prior-topology bitwise claim is made.
Historical primary/fixed predictions and internal source points/centroids/areas/normals replay job 304002 bitwise in each precision.
Observed L_ref equals 5.0 exactly, observed model reference_length equals 8.0 exactly, and the resulting effective physical length is 40.0.
Running the canonical builder twice gives bitwise-identical float32 bundle tensors and identical topology.
Canonical tensors have exact expected shapes/order, are finite, have strictly positive areas, unit normals within 1e-6, and area-centred centroids within 1e-6 after the one float32 cast.
Injected centroids/areas/normals equal the canonical tensors exactly in both derived paths.
Injected points/centroids/areas/normals equal the canonical tensors exactly in both full paths.
Canonical trace queries are exact, and neutral decode uses center exactly zero and reference length exactly one.
Same-input primary replay is fieldwise bitwise exact for both interventions.
Atomic JSON/NPZ sidecars pass and the producer output schema contains no forbidden scientific keys.

decision_rules.derived_pass: Pressure and WSS relative L2 are each at most 0.001 for every primary-versus-fixed comparison across four cases and both precisions. One field/case/precision failure fails this arm.
decision_rules.full_pass: Pressure and WSS are each bitwise exact for every primary-versus-fixed comparison across four cases and both precisions. A merely small nonzero difference fails this arm.
decision_rules.FULL_AND_DERIVED_PASS: All validity gates plus both decision gates pass. This licenses implementation of the coherent full canonical path as an opt-in production candidate, not permanent use of the hybrid derived pin.
decision_rules.FULL_ONLY_PASS: All validity gates and full_pass hold, but derived_pass fails. This refutes the reduced derived-only repair and licenses only full coherent-bundle production prototyping.
decision_rules.CANONICAL_REPAIR_REFUTED: Validity passes but full_pass fails. Do not implement this design; audit remaining frame-dependent state and escalate to preserving raw geometry or float64 farther upstream, with no arm selection.
decision_rules.INVALID_DIAGNOSTIC: Any required validity gate fails. Preserve safe artifacts, repair only the instrument, and make no mechanistic interpretation.
decision_rules.execution_status: FULL_AND_DERIVED_PASS, FULL_ONLY_PASS, and CANONICAL_REPAIR_REFUTED are all valid diagnostic outcomes and must exit zero. Only INVALID_DIAGNOSTIC exits nonzero.

checks: Verify JSON and NPZ sidecars and the complete copied job-bundle manifest.
Independently recompute every primary-versus-fixed and same-input pressure/WSS comparison from NPZ arrays and match JSON.
Independently recompute all decision gates and the schema-v2 outcome label.
Confirm the JSON/NPZ key sets contain no forbidden target, truth, error, force, area-objective, H-QC endpoint, eligibility, support, futility, or mixed data.

after_full_pass: Implement the full coherent canonical geometry path behind an opt-in production contract without changing trained weights.
Add unit, gradient, compile, similarity/translation, topology/permutation, and performance tests.
Freeze and run target-free full-36-case by five-resolution center/translation validity.
Only after target-free validity, separately preregister an exact historical-10k truth-replay accuracy/noninferiority gate.
not_licensed: Any H-QC endpoint computation or verdict
A bfloat16 or float32 H-QC rerun
Selection of primary, fixed-S10000, or whichever arm is closer

interpretation_limits: A pass establishes neutral-frame engineering stability only for this checkpoint, four K=2500 canaries, two precision contexts, and two historical translations.
Shared-full exactness is an integration gate partly guaranteed by construction, not new causal confirmation.
The result is not accuracy, generalization, full-cohort, multiresolution, training, gradient, compile, memory, or runtime evidence.
Distances from the neutral output to either historical arm may be reported symmetrically but are never gates or selection criteria.
Pin interventions do not support additive component shares.
No outcome decides H-QC or an architecture hypothesis.
